mappedContracts.statement: Use the newest TypeScript next/nightly compiler as the primary compiler and type checker, including relevant native TypeScript 7 experimental parallelism controls.
acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript next is exact-pinned and is the compiler used by build and required CI.
Benchmark and configure --checkers and --builders, and retain --singleThreaded as a deterministic diagnostic mode.
Use the TypeScript 6 compatibility package only where a tool still requires the legacy programmatic API; it must not replace the primary compiler.
All removed/deprecated compiler options and type errors are resolved rather than suppressed.

mappedContracts.statement: Establish performance budgets and privacy-preserving OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics, and traces for CLI, MCP, simulator, parser, state, and release operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Telemetry export is opt-in and local/no-export by default.
Benchmarks cover startup, parse, plan, catalogue, simulator, and state operations.
Regressions beyond approved budgets block merge.
